item.title: Append a Clean End Card

turns.text: Keep this whole 7-second clip, then add a 2-second black end card with white text: 'Ready for takeoff?' and '@flightschool' underneath. Center both lines. Keep the original sound, but make the end card silent.

item.tests: Tests appending an accurately timed end card with exact text while preserving the complete source clip and its audio.

answer_sheet.End-card wording: Ready for takeoff? on the first line and @flightschool underneath, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.End-card appearance: Solid black background, white text, both lines centered. Font choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Timing and transition: Preserve the complete 7-second source, then show the end card for 2 seconds, making a 9-second video. A direct cut is fine.
answer_sheet.Framing and audio: Match the source aspect ratio. Preserve its original sound for the first 7 seconds; the end card is silent.

must_haves: The entire original cockpit clip plays before the end card, without being replaced or shortened.
A solid black end card occupies only the final 2 seconds of the 7-second output.
The end card reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' on the line below.
Both lines are white, centered, fully visible, and comfortably readable.
Original cockpit audio is preserved during the source footage, followed by silence during the end card.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 7 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter, for 7 seconds total, and keep everything else the same.
